name: Unfortunate News

angles.text: As a Mage, you may recognize the damaged, glowing blue crystal as an artifact. High Elder Shadowsong investigates the cultists and takes the crystal for study.

faq.answer: You find the defecting cultist dead before they can speak. Beneath the body lies a damaged, glowing blue crystal, which you carry to High Elder Talanaanis Shadowsong.
faq.q: What is the quest Unfortunate News?

faq.answer: The turncoat was a defecting cultist you were sent to meet. They were killed before they could speak or escape, leaving a still-warm body and a damaged crystal.
Talanaanis Shadowsong is an elf and the High Elder in Valanaar. He directs investigations into the cultists and receives the damaged crystal from the turncoat's body.
The damaged blue crystal is a small, glowing crystal found beneath the fallen turncoat. High Elder Shadowsong finds it interesting and takes it from you.
faq.q: What is the damaged blue crystal?

faq.answer: Valanaar is where High Elder Talanaanis Shadowsong resides. You return there with your report and the recovered crystal.
faq.q: Where does this quest take place?

aliases: what quest comes before unfortunate news
faq.answer: This follows The Turncoat, in which you set out to find the defecting cultist. You arrive too late to save them.
faq.q: How does this quest connect to The Turncoat?

sections.body: You reach the rendezvous and find the defecting cultist already slain. Their body is still warm. Beneath it lies a small, glowing blue crystal, damaged but still humming. You carry it to High Elder Talanaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
sections.title: A Broken Rendezvous

sections.body: You return to Valanaar alone and tell High Elder Talanaanis Shadowsong that the turncoat died before giving testimony. The loss of a living contact is a serious setback. Yet the damaged blue crystal catches the High Elder's eye. He finds it interesting and takes it from you.
sections.title: Shadowsong's Investigation

summary: You find the turncoat dead before they can speak. A damaged blue crystal remains beneath the body, and you carry it to High Elder Talanaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
